March 22, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
Founders Financial Securities Llc decreased its stake in Novo (NVO) by 49.31% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Founders Financial Securities Llc sold 10,734 shares as the company’s stock rose 15.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 11,033 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $531,000, down from 21,767 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Founders Financial Securities Llc who had been investing in Novo for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $120.21B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.44% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $49.53. About 621,986 shares traded. Novo Nordisk A/S (NYSE:NVO) has declined 23.93% since March 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 40.63% the S&P500. 
Hays Advisory Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.7% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hays Advisory Llc sold 2,708 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 32,442 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $5.00M, down from 35,150 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hays Advisory Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $866.59 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.28% or $0.48 during the last trading session, reaching $170.79. About 31.13M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
